negatives.composition: ~10 same-domain-but-different-method (organic electronics talks about e.g. synthesis or spectroscopy with none of the anchor's method axes - the system must NOT match these) + ~40 random unrelated talks (system must stay silent)
negatives.expected_outcome: engine returns no method-match for every negative; empty result is the correct answer
